# /crav1-implement-task

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Build tasks](../../from-plan-to-build.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-implement-task/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Implement exactly one task from tasks.md, then run its verify step.

One `tasks.md` row, then run its verify step.

Before the tests, checks the local dependencies they need (Azurite, a database container, an emulator) and asks start, skip, or stop for one that is not running. Tests skipped for a missing dependency do not tick the row unless you chose skip.

## Runs when

Build one task. Called by the user and by `crav1-complete-task-agent`.

## Reads

In short: One `T#`, the plan, and the spec.

Reads one `T#` in `tasks.md`, plus `plan.md` and `spec.md`.

## Writes

In short: The code and checks that `T#` names, and `[x]` on that row when its verify passes.

Writes the code and the checks that row names, and marks the row `[x]` only when that verify passes.

## Does not

Leaves `spec.md` and other tasks alone.

Limits and exceptions: stops with no code when `## Linter` says none and the user has not chosen to go on. It does not ask to run [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md).

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-verify-spec`](crav1-verify-spec.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-feature-branch`](crav1-feature-branch.md) before code.

## Lane and group

Lane: Build. Group: Build. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).
